thread_analysis.thread_summary: Kokuyo (contact Youko Yamamoto) contacts Allion regarding DID (Declaration ID, now called RN - Registration Number) purchase for a new product development project, spanning April 1-11, 2025. Thread covers entirely administrative and transactional matters: whether to purchase DIDs through Allion or directly from SIG, SIG portal login instructions, password reset assistance, Invoice retrieval from SIG accounts, and ordering/billing procedures. No distinct technical Bluetooth certification questions or cases.
all_questions_found: (Administrative, not cased) - Can Allion arrange DID purchase from SIG, or should the customer purchase directly? What is the cost and process? How to obtain an Invoice from the SIG portal? How to reset SIG account password and log in? What ordering/billing documentation is required to begin work?
thread_analysis.key_administrative_content: SIG DID (RN) purchase pricing (Adopter tier $11,040, Associate tier $5,520), Allion's DID purchase intermediary service (¥100,000 wire-transfer fee + SIG registration fee converted at TTS rate), SIG portal login process (Member Login via Bluetooth SIG website), Invoice retrieval requirement (customer account holder must retrieve Invoice from SIG portal), password reset troubleshooting (confirming older 2023 credentials may still be valid), ordering documentation requirements (formal quotation from Allion + customer purchase order or confirmation email to authorize work start).
thread_analysis.decision_logic: This thread contains no distinct technical questions about Bluetooth certification, registration strategy, testing requirements, or QDID selection. All content is transactional: DID sourcing, portal access, and ordering procedures. Standard administrative processing.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: No technical risks; purely administrative/logistics. Risk is only operational (ordering delays if Invoice not retrieved in time, or account access issues if credentials forgotten).
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Standard DID purchase intermediary service; no technical guidance required. Process is straightforward: customer obtains Invoice from SIG portal, Allion arranges wire transfer, customer signs purchase order/quotation to authorize Allion to proceed.
